review_scope: Independent review of nightly_failure_reporting saved-grant backend; author regression replay of own account controls/guard is distinguished below

doc_review.note: Full final doc reviewed after coordinator added privacy/role observations; doc changed while tests ran, runtime/test sources did not.

findings.finding: No registered privacy reader could ignore retained same-app history before existing-grant verification.
findings.resolution: Provider proof always checks retained namespace; unavailable reader with history refuses. Generic consent additionally checks metadata scope.

findings.finding: A new unresolved privacy receipt after genuine verification could be bypassed by generic account enable.
findings.resolution: Account consent and final witness now use current indexed ownership/receipt metadata; unknown retained scopes refuse, pause preserves history. This guard was authored by this reviewer and independently reviewed separately.

limits: Only synthetic credentials and intercepted provider reads; network-none Docker and no external calls.
No production publishing, uploads, worker, generation, credential or ownership activation/mutation.
Account privacy guard is not independently reviewed by its author; see backend-independent final supplemental reviewer receipt.
These tests do not establish ingress privacy resolution, ownership backfill, storage custody or provider delivery.
